summary: P0 1.8 -- deck EOS/watchdog containment. First poisoned slot triggers a systemd-driven policy restart with an atomic per-boot LogItem-occurrence anti-replay marker (never per-Track). Adds explicit engine-unit StartLimit=3/10min and a deferred post-seek-EOS re-check so a stalled deck retires inside the guard window instead of waiting for the 30s stuck-deck watchdog. No migrations.
